text:
[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part VIII · Suits Relating to Trusts and Trust Property
 Section: 94::Twelve years.
]


To set aside a transfer of immovable property comprised in a Hindu, Muslim or Buddhist religious or charitable endowment, made by a manager thereof for a valuable consideration.
Period of limitationTwelve years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the transfer becomes known to the plaintiff.
